name: dcf-guidebook-br-admin1-legal-reserve-ratios
title: Brazil state-level Legal Reserve (Reserva Legal) ratios, Table F-1
description: Minimum Legal Reserve (Reserva Legal) requirements by Brazilian state (GADM 4.1 admin-1) and native vegetation class under Art. 12 of Law No. 12,651/2012. Machine-readable Table F-1 from Navigating data for deforestation and conversion free (DCF) supply chain analyses: applied learnings from soy in Brazil, Appendix F.

sources.title: Brazil. (2012). Law No. 12,651 of May 25, 2012 (Native Vegetation Protection Law). Presidency of the Republic, Casa Civil. Retrieved January 23, 2026, from https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2011-2014/2012/lei/l12651.htm

fields.name: gid_1
fields.description: GADM 4.1 level-1 identifier (e.g. BRA.1_1). Primary join key (GADM field GID_1).

fields.name: hasc_1
fields.description: GADM 4.1 HASC_1 code (e.g. BR.AC). Secondary GADM join key; complete for all 27 states.

fields.name: gadm_version
fields.description: GADM release the gid_1 and hasc_1 codes refer to.

fields.name: ibge_cd_uf
fields.description: IBGE two-digit state code (CD_UF). Alternative join key; stored as text.

fields.name: art12_region
fields.description: Art. 12 region: legal_amazon (Art. 12, I) or rest_of_brazil (Art. 12, II). Legal Amazon follows Law 12,651/2012 Art. 3, I (13°S parallel for TO and GO).

fields.name: vegetation_class
fields.description: Art. 12 native vegetation class: forest, cerrado, campos_gerais, or all (rest of Brazil).

fields.name: vegetation_class_label
fields.description: Human-readable region and vegetation class as printed in Table F-1.

fields.name: legal_reserve_min_share
fields.description: Minimum Reserva Legal as a share (0-1) of rural property area.

fields.name: max_alt_land_use_share
fields.description: Maximum share (0-1) of rural property area eligible for alternative land use, before APP and other restrictions (= 1 - legal_reserve_min_share). Not a clearing entitlement.

fields.name: legal_basis
fields.description: Article of Law 12,651/2012 setting the percentage.
